name: haversine
description: Distance and bearing between points on the Earth: the haversine great-circle distance on a sphere (R = 6371.0088 km by default) and Vincenty's inverse formula on the WGS-84 or GRS80 ellipsoid (the more exact, to about half a millimetre), with initial and final bearings, the midpoint, and the destination reached from a start point, a bearing and a distance (spherical and Vincenty direct). One pair or a batch of pairs; km, m, statute miles or nautical miles; coordinates as decimal degrees or DMS strings. Near-antipodal pairs where Vincenty does not converge are reported, not looped on.

from.description: Point: [lat, lon] or {lat, lon}; numbers, decimal strings or DMS strings such as "50 03 59N"

pairs.description: Inverse batch: [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2] or {from, to}

bearing.description: Destination: initial bearing in degrees, or DMS

radius_km.description: Sphere radius for the haversine results

catalog.source: original; haversine, bearing, midpoint and destination formulas as on Movable Type Scripts (Veness, 'Calculate distance, bearing and more between latitude/longitude points'); T. Vincenty, 'Direct and inverse solutions of geodesics on the ellipsoid', Survey Review 23 (176), 1975; test case from Geoscience Australia
